metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need optical imagery (Sentinel-2 or Landsat) for Santa Monica coast on October 10, 2015 - Sentinel-2 started June 2015, so should check availability - Landsat 8 as fallback - Location: Santa Monica coast, California (~34.0°N, -118.5°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Need clear water pixels to detect algae blooms - Should mask clouds to see water surface - Algae blooms typically show up as: * High chlorophyll (green/yellow water) * Can use NDVI or specific band ratios * High reflectance in green band, lower in blue * Or use chlorophyll indices 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid detection: If we can calculate water color/indices and detect anomalous green/high reflectance - C1: No images available for the date - C2: All pixels masked (clouds/land) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Evidence of algae bloom (high NDVI in water, anomalous green) - B: No evidence of algae bloom (normal water color) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Santa Monica coastal area const santaMonica = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.5, 34.0]); const coastalRegion = santaMonica.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for coastal waters const targetDate = '2015-10-10'; const dateRange = 3; // days before/after console.log('Analyzing algae bloom for Santa Monica coast, Oct 10, 2015...'); // Try Sentinel-2 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(coastalRegion) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collectionSize}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if no Sentinel-2 if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(coastalRegion) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images available for the date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get the image closest to target date const image = collection.sort('system:time_start').first(); const imageDate = ee.Date(image.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); console.log(`Using image from: ${imageDate}`); // Determine if Sentinel-2 or Landsat const isSentinel = collection.first().bandNames().contains('B2').getInfo(); let processedImage; if (isSentinel) { // Sentinel-2: Simple cloud mask and calculate NDVI const cloudMask = image.select('QA60').eq(0); processedImage = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDVI (NIR-Red)/(NIR+Red) - B8 and B4 processedImage = processedImage.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } else { // Landsat 8: Apply scaling and cloud mask const cloudMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0); const scaled = image.select(['SR_B[2-5]', 'SR_B7']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); processedImage = scaled.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDVI (B5-B4)/(B5+B4) processedImage = processedImage.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } // Check valid pixel count const pixelCount = processedImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid water pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI over coastal waters const meanNDVI = processedImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI: ${meanNDVI !== null ? meanNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); if (meanNDVI === null || isNaN(meanNDVI)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for algae bloom indicators // Water typically has negative NDVI // Algae blooms show positive NDVI (0.1 to 0.3 range) if (meanNDVI > 0.05) { console.log('Positive NDVI indicates algae bloom visible.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Normal water signature, no algae bloom detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
